status: female storybook candidates only; not integrated
basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new landscape 3:2 female-version game-ending illustration. Input image 1 is COMPOSITION ONLY: preserve camera angle, character placement, scale, cropping and gesture. Images 2,3,4 are STYLE/MEDIUM references ONLY: playful handmade children's fairy-tale picture-book artwork, textured wax crayon, colored pencils, dry gouache, visible paper grain, softly irregular contours, simplified expressive faces, decorative collage-like stars and vegetation, luminous pastel color against deep midnight fields. Strongly transform away from glossy realistic/anime rendering of image 1. Do not copy lettering, watermark, artist signatures, exact characters or layout from style refs. Preserve character identities and the scene described, with storybook rather than polished anime proportions. Adult characters, not children. No lettering, captions, logos, watermarks, panel borders, or extra limbs.
variants: A: crisp wax-crayon and colored-pencil storybook, mint and coral peach highlights, deep indigo shadows, warm butter-yellow stars, rich visible paper grain. Expressive restrained linework, delicately joyful magic.
B: soft pastel and smudged colored-pencil fairy-tale, muted rose lavender apricot, emerald accents, charcoal midnight edges, hazy luminous atmosphere. Tactile dreamy hand-drawn quality.

C: decorative gouache and colored-pencil storybook, saturated jade turquoise chartreuse and warm orange-pink against velvety dark navy, flat interlocking color shapes, sparkling cream stars, lightly scratched and stippled paper textures.
